# CourseMate - Learning Management System

A lightweight yet feature-rich learning management system built with Django for schools and colleges. Manage students, courses, assessments, and track academic progress with ease.

## Key Features
- Student and lecturer management
- Course enrollment and management
- Quiz system with multiple question types
- Grade calculation and reporting
- PDF report generation
- Session and semester management
- Course materials (videos and documentation)
- Dashboard with analytics

## Technologies
- Python 3.8+
- Django Web Framework
- SQLite/PostgreSQL
- Bootstrap

Active development - Contributions welcome! ⭐
